documents.title: Intimation Of Cancellation Of Schedule Of Analyst/ Investor Meeting(S) Scheduled On November 16, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals reported strong financial performance for Q2 FY27, with revenue growing 24% year-on-year to INR 2,820 crores and EBITDA increasing 31% to INR 575 crores. Management raised the full-year FY27 revenue growth outlook to exceed 20% and expects EBITDA margin improvement at the upper end of the 75 to 100 basis points range. Growth was supported by both domestic and international markets, including strong momentum in Europe, Canada, and emerging markets. Additionally, the company's board approved the amalgamation of Zuventus Healthcare and Emcutix Biopharmaceuticals into Emcure. Emcure Pharmaceuticals reported its Q2FY27 financial results with an operating revenue of INR 28,205 million, marking a 24.3% YoY growth, and an EBITDA of INR 5,748 million, reflecting a 30.9% YoY increase.

guidance.claim: Management now expects revenue growth to exceed 20% for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: We now expect revenue growth to exceed 20% compared to mid-teens mentioned earlier.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margin improvement for the year is expected to be at the upper end of the guidance range of 75 to 100 basis points.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin improvement for the year is now expected to be at the upper end of our guidance range of 75 to 100 basis points.

guidance.claim: Management expects organic domestic growth to accelerate in the second half of the fiscal year.
guidance.quote: We expect to build upon this improvement in the second half of the current fiscal year.

guidance.claim: The company expects continued growth over the full year as the strengthened team and portfolio gain traction.
guidance.quote: Expect continued growth over the full year as our strengthened team and portfolio gain traction

demand_outlook.claim: Business momentum in Europe is expected to continue into the second half of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Business momentum is expected to continue in second half as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects further product launches in Canada during the second half.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect further launches in the second half, and we continue to build a very strong pipeline for the Canadian market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the rest of the world business to continue growing over the year.
demand_outlook.quote: And we do expect our rest of world business to continue to grow over the year, and that is going to be backed by science, technology, innovation, about which I've been speaking in all the investor calls.

demand_outlook.claim: The dermatology industry in India is growing at approximately 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 EBITDA margins expanded by about 100 basis points year-on-year to 20.4% driven by productivity gains and operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA rose 31% to INR575 crores and the EBITDA margins expanded by about 100 basis points to 20.4%, driven by productivity gains and operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased by 20% to INR669 crores primarily due to higher sales and higher R&D expenditure.
margins_costs.quote: Other expenses were INR669 crores, up 20%, primarily on account of higher sales and higher R&D expenditure.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin stood at 11.5%, up 45 bps YoY.
Gross Profit Margin for Q2FY27 was 59.5%, compared to 60.8% in Q2FY26.
Gross profit margin for FY26 stood at 60.3%, showing an increase of 20 bps year-over-year.
EBITDA margin for FY26 was 19.4%, reflecting an 80 bps increase compared to the previous year.
PAT margin for FY26 reached 10.2%, representing a 120 bps increase year-over-year.
